import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0]); out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    twos=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j,x in enumerate(inp[i]) if x==2]
    rs=[i for i,_ in twos]; cs=[j for _,j in twos]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs); band=set(range(r0,r1+1))
    # gather outside-band markers per row
    mrow={i:[j for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]!=0 and not(c0<=j<=c1)] for i in range(H)}
    markrows=sorted(i for i,ms in mrow.items() if ms)
    # rows strictly between two marker rows -> fully filled
    segs=[]
    prev=None
    for m in markrows:
        if prev is not None and m>prev+1:
            segs.append((prev+1,m-1))
        prev=m
    if prev is not None and prev<r1:
        segs.append((prev+1,r1))
    for a,b in segs:
        for i in range(a,b+1):
            for j in range(W): out[i][j]=2
    # marker rows: fill away from marker side
    for i,ms in mrow.items():
        if i not in band: continue
        left=[m for m in ms if m<c0]; right=[m for m in ms if m>c1]
        if left and not right: rng=range(c1+1,W)   # fill right
        elif right and not left: rng=range(0,c0)  # fill left
        else: continue
        for j in rng: out[i][j]=2
    # vertical: above/below bands: marker columns rel-complement across whole band height
    for side,rrng,src in [(range(0,r0),'top',[i for i,j in [] ]),]: pass
    topp=[(i,j) for i in range(0,r0) for j,x in enumerate(inp[i]) if x!=0 and not(c0<=j<=c1)]
    bott=[(i,j) for i in range(r1+1,H) for j,x in enumerate(inp[i]) if x!=0 and not(c0<=j<=c1)]
    w=c1-c0+1
    if topp:
        trel={j-c0 for _,j in topp}; cols=[j for j in range(c0,c1+1) if (j-c0) not in trel]
        for i in range(0,r0):
            for j in cols: out[i][j]=2
    if bott:
        brel={j-c0 for _,j in bott}; cols=[j for j in range(c0,c1+1) if (j-c0) not in brel]
        for i in range(r1+1,H):
            for j in cols: out[i][j]=2
    return out

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def analyze(I,O):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); out=[r[:] for r in I]
    twos=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j,x in enumerate(I[i]) if x==2]
    rs=[i for i,_ in twos]; cs=[j for _,j in twos]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    # markers above/below band
    topp=[(i,j) for i in range(0,r0) for j,x in enumerate(I[i]) if x!=0 and not(c0<=j<=c1)]
    bott=[(i,j) for i in range(r1+1,H) for j,x in enumerate(I[i]) if x!=0 and not(c0<=j<=c1)]
    def rel(s): return sorted({j-c0 for _,j in s})
    print('=== ',k)
    print('block r%d-%d c%d-%d w=%d'%(r0,r1,c0,c1,c1-c0+1))
    print('top markers rel:',rel(topp),' | expected top lines rel:', rel([(i,j) for i in range(r0) for j,x in enumerate(O[i]) if x==2 and not any(I[a][b]!=2 and a==i and b!=j for a,b in twos)]) )
    botexp=rel([(i,j) for i in range(r1+1,len(O)) for j,x in enumerate(O[i]) if x==2 and not any(I[a][b]!=2 and a==i and b!=j for a,b in twos)])
    print('bot markers rel:',rel(bott),' | expected bot stripes rel:',botexp)
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    analyze(G[k+' input'],G[k+' output'])

inp=G['Demo pair 1 input']; b=np.array(inp); H,W=b.shape
vals,counts=np.unique(b,return_counts=True)
bandc=int(vals[np.argmax([c for v,c in zip(vals,counts) if v!=0])])
rs,cs=np.where(b==bandc)
r0,r1,c0,c1=int(rs.min()),int(rs.max()),int(cs.min()),int(cs.max())
print('bandcolor',bandc,'bbox',r0,r1,c0,c1,'grid',H,W)
mk=[(int(i),int(j)) for i,j in zip(*np.where((b!=0)&(b!=bandc)))]
print('mk',mk)
upc={j for i,j in mk if i<r0}; downc={j for i,j in mk if i>r1}
Lr={i for i,j in mk if j<c0}; Rr={i for i,j in mk if j>c1}
print('upc',sorted(upc),'downc',sorted(downc),'Lr',Lr,'Rr',Rr)
# vertical fill test manually
out=b.copy()
for j in range(c0,c1+1):
    if j not in upc:
        for i in range(r0):
            out[i][j]=bandc
print(np.argwhere(out[0]!=b[0])[0])
